name: Nagatoro Yuriko
source:
Naoki's second wife. Yuuki is still unfamiliar with her so he calls her "Yuriko-san". She is a colleague(kouhai) at the company where Naoki works and seems to have been friends with Shouko as well.

She is a bit withdrawn and can easily become distressed. She has a great style and a well-proportioned figure. She has been solicited by many modeling agencies because she looks young for her age.

She had some reservations about remarrying her friend's husband, but with Shouko's encouragement, the marriage was consummated.

After marriage, she became a full-time housewife, but she is concerned that her stepson does not call her Mama.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complets/MC4/]official site[/url]]
